description: Knowledge about mathematical concepts, logic, calculations, and problem solving.

topics.name: Mathematical Foundations
knowledge: Mathematics is the study of numbers, patterns, structures, and relationships.
Mathematical reasoning uses logic to solve problems and prove ideas.
Numbers can represent quantities, measurements, and information.

topics.name: Arithmetic
knowledge: Arithmetic focuses on basic operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
Fractions represent parts of a whole.
Percentages express values as parts of one hundred.

topics.name: Algebra
knowledge: Algebra uses symbols and variables to represent unknown values.
Functions describe how one quantity changes based on another.

topics.name: Geometry
knowledge: Geometry studies shapes, sizes, angles, and spaces.
Lines, circles, triangles, and polygons are basic geometric objects.
Geometry is used in engineering, architecture, graphics, and design.

topics.name: Statistics and Probability
knowledge: Statistics analyzes data and discovers patterns.
Probability measures the likelihood of events happening.
Data analysis helps make informed decisions.

topics.name: Advanced Mathematics
knowledge: Calculus studies change, motion, and continuous processes.
Linear algebra studies vectors and matrices.
Mathematics supports computer science, physics, economics, and artificial intelligence.
